title: Ramp reaches $60B valuation as it pushes deeper into AI | TechCrunch
summary: Expense management company Ramp said on Thursday that it had raised $1.85 billion in a new funding round that values it at $60 billion, just four months after raising $750 million at a $44 billion valuation .
